name: box-office
description: Connects Claude Code to Box Office, the local dashboard of your chats: sends it the hook events it watches, adds /office (status, open, start), a status band above the prompt, and an opt-in check of each tool call against the office's Coordinator rules. Talks to 127.0.0.1 only.

port.title: Box Office port
port.description: The port Box Office listens on (127.0.0.1). The plugin's hooks always post to 3001; for another port install the hooks with npm run install-hooks -- --port N.

boxOfficePath.title: Box Office folder
boxOfficePath.description: Your Box Office checkout (the folder with bin/box-office.js), for /office start. Leave empty to look next to this plugin and in the marketplace copy.

dataDir.title: Box Office data folder
dataDir.description: Where the office keeps its data and its .office-token file. Leave empty for the office's own default.

coordinator.title: Coordinator in Claude Code
coordinator.description: Ask Box Office's Coordinator rules about each tool call Claude Code would allow, with a native question for 'ask' rules. Off by default.

coordinatorFailClosed.title: Refuse tool calls when Box Office is down
coordinatorFailClosed.description: With the coordinator on: refuse a tool call the office cannot check (it is unreachable). Off: let it through and show a warning.

statusBand.title: Status band
statusBand.description: Show one line above the prompt: chats that need you, context, cost and plan usage.
